body: 071 conditionally admitted: 5/5 report and 19/19 nested pins match. Reported CR-1457 crimping support resolves the branch's source question with transfer limits; the model core modulus is not shown to be the required minimum. Same-film CTE remains unsourced: signed HOPG is a different product. Thus 'no feasible shell' is confined to the copied thermal law, proxy and search, not all physical graphite/aluminum designs. Release near core CTE 12.2e-6/K holds stiffness fixed and identifies no qualified replacement core. The 3.467/3.137 density factors are just-feasible-boundary results; R20 reaches the 2.4-mm grid floor, not a proven global optimum. Scarf 10 MPa is an owner screen; doubling it is ineffective only in the reported boundary case. Private papers were identified by public titles, not fully inspected. These limits remain relevant to 069's graphite comparison. Version 8 remains authoritative; no new record append or further review requested.
